en: A black‑and‑white view of a quiet tree‑lined street with a large stone tower on the left side behind a low wall and dense foliage. The tower has a steep tiled roof with stepped gables and small windows, reminiscent of a medieval church or fortified tower. Old-style street lamps line the unpaved road, which curves off into the distance. There are no visible people or vehicles, and the surrounding area appears semi-rural.
